# Code of Conduct

This is a small project, maintained by one person. The rule is simple: treat others with respect.

- Be constructive in issues and pull requests: criticism of the code, yes; attacks on people, no.
- Harassment, discriminatory language, or deliberately hostile behavior will not be tolerated.
- If you have a problem with someone's conduct in this repository, write to **filonux@proton.me**.

The project maintainer may remove comments, close issues or pull requests, or block anyone who violates this, without further explanation than necessary.
